 What Awaits You
Being a passionate Frontend Developer, you care about code development and review
Version control using tools like Git
Automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end)
Monitoring and logging for application and infrastructure performance
Collaboration and communication with team members and stakeholders
Agile development in an iterative and incremental manner
Documentation maintenance for code
 What Should You Bring Along
University Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business or a related field
At least 5 years of experience in a similar Angular Developer role is required
Experience in Frontend development using ES6, Angular 2+ WebComponents, CSS, HTML5, REST
Experience in Databases using SQL
Experience in writing unit tests using Web Component Tester, Sinon, Mocha
Experience in debugging and developing for multiple browsers and devices
Experience with projects with end-customer focus
High analytical thinking skills and level of quality awareness
Self-motivated and a high willingness to learn
Able to work independently and proactively
Excellent English verbal and written skills
German communication skills will be a plus
